name: Project Resource Management
excerpt: Project Resource Management involves organizing and managing project resources effectively.
notes: Project Resource Management involves organizing and managing project resources effectively. It includes tools like the Project Organizational Chart and the Responsibility Assignment Matrix, which maps tasks to responsible individuals. The RACI Chart is used to define roles and responsibilities, and the Staffing Management Plan describes how team members are added or removed.
context_summary:
- Organizes and manages project resources effectively.
- Utilizes tools like Project Organizational Chart and Responsibility Assignment Matrix.
- RACI Chart defines roles and responsibilities.
- Staffing Management Plan describes team member changes.
